name: app-starters
description: Prompts that have an agent build an interactive app people use from a link (a poll, a survey, a sign-up sheet) and report on what they answered.

prompts.title: Build a poll
prompts.body: Build a poll as an interactive app: "{{question}}" with the options {{options}}. One vote per person (a vote can be changed until it closes), {{results}}, closing {{closes}}. Mobile-first, so people can vote from a link on their phones.

prompts.title: Build a survey
prompts.body: Build a short survey as an interactive app about {{topic}} for {{audience}}: {{questions}} Each person answers once; the answers stay private to this room, and respondents see a thank-you. Mobile-first.

variables.name: questions
variables.label: Questions
variables.default: a 1 to 5 rating, what went well and what to change.

prompts.title: Build a sign-up sheet
prompts.body: Build a sign-up sheet as an interactive app for {{event}} with {{places}} places. Each person signs up once with {{fields}}, can take their name off again, and sees who else is coming and how many places are left. Mobile-first.

prompts.title: Report on an app's answers
prompts.body: Read all the data of the {{app}} app in this room and write a report as a Markdown document: {{focus}} Say how many entries you read and which you left out (duplicates, after the close), and quote free text as the people's own words.

variables.name: focus
variables.label: What to report
variables.default: the totals per option, the trend, and a recommendation.
